$comment: Advisories waived for development dependencies only. Shipped (production) dependencies are always audited strictly. Each entry expires; after its expiry the nightly audit (Nightly Security, npm audit (web)) fails again. The required pull-request job audits only shipped dependencies and does not read this file. Owner allowed waivers for advisories with no fix on 2026-11-13 (fix all CI).

advisories.reason: Denial of service through glob pattern amplification, fixed only in minimatch 11.0.1. The newest eslint (10.14.0) and @eslint/config-array still require minimatch ^10.2.6, and the newest js-beautify (via @vue/test-utils) reaches it through editorconfig ^3 and glob ^13. All are lint and test tools run on patterns from this repository; none is in the shipped frontend. Drop this entry once eslint and js-beautify accept minimatch 11.

An aborted AbortSignal does not stop the walk, fixed only in glob 14.0.2. Reached only through js-beautify (pretty printing in @vue/test-utils), whose newest release still requires glob ^13 and never passes a signal. Test tooling only, not in the shipped frontend.
